- [u-L0005-08] After conferring with Lysandra, they determine that they are 3 days from Mirathorn and the next little town north along the road will be Mireward, about 5 days out.
- [meta-session-0020-open-loops] session unresolved open questions loops open loops actionable follow up next session half_burned_warehouse Should the half-burned warehouse be promoted as a Mossford location dossier, or folded into an existing Mossford district dossier such as Dense Worker Housing? elderwyld cities and towns cities and towns mossford location dossiers mossford location dossiers half burned warehouse half burned warehouse professor_merril_tealeaf Should Professor Tealeaf receive a dedicated NPC hub under Stormsp
- [u-L0017-07] Lysandra tells her that she can't remember much after the group left, only that she decided to go around the forest and she could smell meat while trying to sleep.
- [u-L0005-07] From this position they can see out along the plains for a fairly long distance.
- [u-L0017-04] She tells Caelynn that all she could hear was mumbling about the forest leaving and that something strange happened to the time.
- [u-L0019-12] She is very confused, wondering where she is and how she got there.
- [u-L0003-14] They warn the sheriff about tainted meat and Karsemine uses her Thaumaturgy to show them what to look for when people begin to change.
- [u-L0017-05] Sara then connects Caelynn directly to Lysandra who is relieved and overjoyed that the group is ok and that they took care of the forest.
- [u-L0019-13] All that she is able to remember is voices in the dark after the group left into the forest.

- [meta-session-0021-open-loops] session unresolved open questions loops open loops actionable follow up next session mirathorn_festival_resumed Mirathorn resumed the Festival; Frank hung up; Lysandra cannot get through — is the city compromised or merely distracted? elderwyld cities and towns cities and towns mirathorn swamp_vs_mirathorn_fork Party agreed to press on to the swamp rather than turn back — S22 opening pressure. longmont campaign longmont campaign campaign 2 parties questionable company questionable company
- [u-L0005-06] They leave the wagon and the animals at the bottom and make their way up until they reach a giant bowl of water surrounded by a grove of trees.
- [u-L0011-05] He apologizes to her, telling Caelynn that the city resumed the Festival and it was a long night.
- [u-L0013-07] Marla then grapples Bonogo and is about to do much worse when Caelynn comes to the rescue.
- [u-L0015-06] Marla approaches Caelynn and asks her how she should deal with Bonogo, but Ephanna quickly intervenes, letting her, and the town, know that the Questionable Company is leaving town to continue their journey.
- [u-L0017-08] She is exhausted and disoriented.
- [u-L0019-11] Finally, after drinking the tea, Lysandra comes out of the spell.
- [u-L0003-12] He warns the group about rumors coming from a town to the north about cultists using music to convert others.
- [u-L0007-03] She shows it to Caelynn to make an arcana check, but she can't tell anything about it.
- [u-L0007-09] Bonogo does not want to leave without taking a look himself, so Karsemine casts Pass Without a Trace and they both sneak back up.
- [u-L0011-01] Stafl is on first watch, with little happening, until the sky darkens further and he can just make out a huge swarm of wings.
- [u-L0013-01] Ephanna moves in to speak with Lysandra and tell her about the earlier call to Mirathorn.
- [u-L0015-05] The mayor and sheriff congratulate the heroes and thank them again for all their help.
- [u-L0017-03] Caelynn relays her request and Sara calls Lysandra.
- [u-L0017-06] Caelynn wants to know if she is ok and where she is.
- [u-L0023-03] Ephanna plans to create a disguise and go back to town for new supplies, but for the moment the group is settling in for a rest around the camp.
